ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Event, TargetType.Self)` (FeedingFrenzy.cs:18-21) == cost 0 / SKILL / EVENT / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<StrengthPower>(5m)` (FeedingFrenzy.cs:14) == `_strength = 5`. Note the var is keyed on StrengthPower but feeds FEEDINGFRENZYPower (FeedingFrenzy.cs:26-27), the temporary-Strength wrapper -- the same key/target mismatch as card/demon_form, checked rather than assumed.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<FeedingFrenzyPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Strength.BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (FeedingFrenzy.cs:27) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, FeedingFrenzyPower, self._strength, applier=ctx.player)`. The sim correctly uses `PowerCmd.apply` rather than `StrengthCmd.apply` here: this is a TemporaryStrength wrapper, not raw Strength, so it must not go through the `modify_strength_given` chain -- and the wrapper is exactly the `ITemporaryPower.InternallyAppliedPower` double-dip bug class, which is the power stream's to audit. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (25) and the Strength hover tip (16).
